chunks: "With regard to the beggars, feed three of them; and if you wish to give more, then give more; otherwise, you have fulfilled the due of your day."

key_terms.أَدَّيْتُمْ: you have fulfilled; you have discharged the duty
key_terms.أَطْعِمُوا: feed; provide food as an act of charity
key_terms.السُّؤَّالِ: beggars; those who ask others for assistance
key_terms.تَزْدَادُوا: increase; give beyond the minimum mentioned
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةً: three; the stated daily number to feed
key_terms.حَقَّ: due; the owed right or obligation
key_terms.يَوْمِكُمْ: your day; the daily measure of this charitable responsibility

ai.seo_question: How many needy people should one feed in a day according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches a practical daily standard of charity by feeding three beggars. The hadith encourages generosity beyond the minimum while indicating that doing so fulfills one's daily charitable duty.
